criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: All five pieces show top planes + front faces only; no side/iso faces.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Compared at 8x against harbour brazier tiles 7513/7514 and the v5 stone in the room renders; same slate ramp, outline weight and shading steps.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: Checked mock-gate.png and mock-vault.png at 1x plus 3x crops: unlit braziers read as laid fuel, dais reads raised with steps.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Riser rows match across centre/L/R/steps (row-by-row pixel check); braziers grounded on the dais.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: No stray pixels, stubs or jaggies found.

items.name: 큰 돌 화로(꺼짐, 2칸, 버들항 돌) (great stone brazier)
reasons: 3/4 correct: elliptical rim top plane visible, bowl/column/foot show front faces only, foot slab has its own top face; no side faces.
Same blue-grey slate ramp and dark outline as the harbour brazier 7513/7514; 4-5 shading steps, light from upper left, no flat fills.
At 1x in mock-gate the four braziers clearly read as laid fuel: pale ash bed, dark charcoal, two crossed barked logs with light cut ends - 'ready to light', not an empty urn.
Grounded by foot slab and 1px contact shadow; sits on 2x2 dais checker without clipping.
Clean closed silhouette, symmetric, no stray pixels or stubs.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(가운데, 1칸) (dais riser stone)
reasons: Front face only below a light top-edge line; rows 0-3 transparent so the dais top continues - correct 3/4 riser.
Mid slate grey courses (two courses, staggered joints at x5/x13 then x1/x9), lip highlight, dark joint lines and dark bottom shadow row; matches v5 stone walls/plinths.
In both mocks the dais now reads as a raised slab with a front face.
Tiles seamlessly: rows identical at both edges, joint stagger repeats every 8px so tiling has no seam.
No stray pixels.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(왼쪽 끝, 1칸) (dais riser stone L)
reasons: Same riser with a 1px dark end outline at x0 and a light inner column at x1 (lit from left) - correct end cap.
Matches centre piece ramps.
Reads as the dais's west corner in mock-gate/mock-vault.
Rows 4-15 align exactly with the centre piece; joins seamlessly.
Clean.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(오른쪽 끝, 1칸) (dais riser stone R)
reasons: Dark end outline at x15 with a mid-tone inner column at x14 (shadow side) - consistent lighting with L.
Matches centre piece ramps.
Reads as the dais's east corner.
Rows align with centre piece; seamless join.
Clean.

items.name: 돌 단 오르는 두 계단(2칸) (dais steps stone)
reasons: Two treads (rows 4-5 at lip level, rows 9-11 intermediate) with darker fronts (rows 6-8, 12-14) and 2px dark cheeks at x2-3 / x28-29 - reads as steps cut into the front, 3/4 correct.
Same ramp as the riser; short staggered joints; bottom shadow row continuous with riser.
At 1x the step notch is visible as a lighter break in the riser in the centre of the dais front, lined up with the carpet runner; at 3x it clearly reads as two shallow steps.
Outer columns x0-1 / x30-31 repeat the riser row pattern so it joins the riser pieces seamlessly; top line coincides with the dais edge.
Clean, symmetric, no jaggies.
